resources.string: Maintains a persistent server-sent-events connection to the user\'s own Claude Code bridge running on their own machine. The bridge denies a permission prompt outright when no client is connected, so holding the connection is the feature: it is what lets the user answer a blocked coding session from their phone.
A session is blocked waiting for your answer.
The ongoing notice that TGXCode is holding a connection to the bridge.
Turn errors, warnings, and messages that failed to send.
